title: Aquarius - Path compare (MQTT vs uXRCE)
description: MQTT stack vs uXRCE stack: latency, rate, gaps, storage. aquarius path mqtt|kafka|both

options.content:
**MQTT stack**: PX4 MAVLink → `mavlink_mqtt.py` → Mosquitto → Telegraf → table `position` (10 Hz).  **uXRCE stack**: PX4 uXRCE-DDS → ROS 2 → `aquarius_bridge` → Kafka → ingestion → table `telemetry` (10 Hz *sim time*, so fewer rows/s when RTF < 1).  
**Latency** = row written (`received_at`, `clock_timestamp()`) − bridge sent it (MQTT: payload `t`, Kafka: message CreateTime). Both clocks are on the same machine. It includes broker + writer batching (Telegraf `flush_interval` 1 s, ingestion `BATCH_MAX_WAIT_S` 1 s). PX4 → bridge is *not* included.  
Pick a stack: `aquarius path mqtt|kafka|both`. CPU / RAM per container and process: `docker/bench_paths.sh`. Rows from before migration 0008 / `aquarius path` are left out (no send time).

panels.title: Summary (time range)
panels.description: One row per stack over the selected time range. rows/s is per drone. max gap = longest time between two rows of the same drone (dropouts). age = time since the newest row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 'MQTT' AS path, drone AS drone, time AS sent, received_at
    FROM "position"
   WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 minute'  -- chunk exclusion
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uXRCE', drone_id, sent_at, received_at
    FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND sent_at IS NOT NULL
), g AS (
  SELECT *, EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - lag(received_at) OVER (PARTITION BY path, drone ORDER BY received_at)) * 1000 AS gap
    FROM s
)
SELECT path AS "stack",
       count(DISTINCT drone) AS "drones",
       count(*) AS "rows",
       count(*) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM max(received_at) - min(received_at)), 0) / count(DISTINCT drone) AS "rows/s per drone",
       percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS "latency p50",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS "latency p95",
       percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS "latency p99",
       max(EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS "latency max",
       max(gap) AS "max gap",
       EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - max(received_at)) AS "age"
  FROM g GROUP BY path ORDER BY path DESC

panels.title: Latency: bridge → database
panels.description: p50 (solid) and p95 (dashed) per time bucket, all drones.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 'MQTT' AS path, drone AS drone, time AS sent, received_at
    FROM "position"
   WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 minute'  -- chunk exclusion
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uXRCE', drone_id, sent_at, received_at
    FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND sent_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval), path,
       percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS p50,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - sent) * 1000) AS p95
  FROM s GROUP BY 1, path ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rows / s per drone
panels.description: Rows written per second per drone (by insert time). Configured: 10 / s on both; uXRCE's is sim time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 'MQTT' AS path, drone AS drone, time AS sent, received_at
    FROM "position"
   WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 minute'  -- chunk exclusion
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uXRCE', drone_id, sent_at, received_at
    FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND sent_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval), path,
       count(*) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) / count(DISTINCT drone) AS "rows/s"
  FROM s GROUP BY 1, path ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Longest gap between rows
panels.description: Max time between two consecutive rows of one drone per bucket. 100 ms = steady 10 Hz; spikes = dropouts or batching.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 'MQTT' AS path, drone AS drone, time AS sent, received_at
    FROM "position"
   WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 minute'  -- chunk exclusion
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uXRCE', drone_id, sent_at, received_at
    FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND sent_at IS NOT NULL
), g AS (
  SELECT path, received_at,
         EXTRACT(epoch FROM received_at - lag(received_at) OVER (PARTITION BY path, drone ORDER BY received_at)) * 1000 AS gap
    FROM s
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval), path, max(gap) AS "max gap"
  FROM g WHERE gap IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, path ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage per table
panels.description: Disk used by each hypertable (incl. indexes). The MQTT stack writes one table per stream; the uXRCE stack one telemetry row with position + attitude + battery + mode.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN h.hypertable_name IN ('telemetry', 'detections', 'survivors', 'replanning_events')
                 THEN 'uXRCE' ELSE 'MQTT' END AS "stack",
       h.hypertable_name AS "table",
       approximate_row_count(format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name)::regclass) AS "rows (approx.)",
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name)::regclass) AS "size",
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name)::regclass)
         / NULLIF(approximate_row_count(format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name)::regclass), 0) AS "bytes / row"
  FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables h
 WHERE h.hypertable_schema = 'public'
   AND (h.hypertable_name IN ('telemetry', 'detections', 'survivors', 'replanning_events')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema = 'public'
                   AND c.table_name = h.hypertable_name AND c.column_name = 'fleet'))
 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC
